title: New Ribs for the Boat
offer: Your hold could carry even more! Bring me three bent oak branches from Arne in Frosttorp and a crate of iron tools, and pay me 10 silver for the work.

steps.load_say: These oaks grew bent in the wind: just right for the ribs of a boat.

steps.say: Done! New ribs, wider planks: your hold takes one more crate.

fact: The ribs of a viking boat were cut from oaks which had grown in the right curve.
